questions.scenario: Bloklanan backend'leri ve hangi pid tarafindan bloklandiklarini goster.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT pid, pg_blocking_pids(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > 0;"
steps.hint_text: Lock zincirini cikarmak icin aktivite gorunumundeki pid'leri bloklayan backend listesiyle eslestir.

questions.scenario: 5 dakikadan uzun suredir calisan aktif query'leri runtime ile listele.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS runtime, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND now() - query_start > interval '5 minutes';"
steps.hint_text: Aktif sorgulari baslangic zamanina gore filtreleyip runtime kolonunu dinamik hesapla.

questions.scenario: Bakim oncesi `app` database'indeki mevcut session'lari kendi session'in haric tutarak sonlandir.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'app' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();"
steps.hint_text: Bakim temizligi yaparken kendi oturumunu korumak icin mevcut backend pid'ini disarida birak.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_created_at ON orders (created_at);"
steps.hint_text: Yazma trafigini minimum etkilemek icin index'i concurrent modda kur.

questions.scenario: `idx_orders_created_at` index'ini production'da yeniden olusturmadan reindex et.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_created_at;"
steps.hint_text: Mevcut index'i minimum kesintiyle yenilemek icin concurrent reindex yolunu kullan.
Hem bakim hem istatistik hem de ayrintili cikti istiyorsan vacuum seceneklerini birlikte ver.

questions.scenario: En fazla dead tuple birikmis ilk 10 user tablosunu goster.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "SELECT relname, n_dead_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 10;"
steps.hint_text: Bloat adayi tablolar icin user table istatistiklerini dead tuple sayisina gore sirala.

questions.scenario: `orders` sorgusunu gercek calisma istatistikleri ve buffer kullanimi ile incele.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42;"
steps.hint_text: Gercek runtime ile I/O izini ayni planda gormek icin analyze ve buffer seceneklerini birlikte ac.

questions.scenario: `app` database'indeki en buyuk 10 user tablosunu boyutlariyla listele.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "SELECT relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS size FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 10;"
steps.hint_text: Kapasite taramasi icin user table istatistiklerinden gidip relation boyutunu okunur formata cevir.

questions.scenario: Replication tarafini hizlica kontrol et: slot'lari listele, sonra `wal_level` degerini gor.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT slot_name, active FROM pg_replication_slots;"
steps.hint_text: Replication slot durumunu katalogdaki ilgili gorunumden oku.
Replication davranisini etkileyen temel WAL ayarini server parametresi olarak sorgula.
